en.summary: Fixes the L2 directory write-way mask so it uses the configured associativity instead of a hardcoded two-way mask.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes an L2Cache bug.
The changed file defines a live directory module instantiated by `Scheduler.scala`, not a standalone host-side test.
The patch corrects executable directory write-enable logic for both normal writes and reset wipe behavior.
disqualifiers: The bug is configuration-dependent and mainly manifests when cache associativity is not 2.
evidence: The patch changes `UIntToOH(io.write.bits.way, 2)` to `UIntToOH(io.write.bits.way, params.cache.ways)` and `Fill(2, !wipeDone)` to `Fill(params.cache.ways, !wipeDone)`.
The surrounding module uses `params.cache.ways` throughout its arrays, status bits, victim selection, and SRAM instantiation, so the old constant was inconsistent with the rest of the DUT.
`ventus/src/L2cache/Scheduler.scala` instantiates `Module(new Directory_test(params))`, confirming this logic is part of the real cache datapath.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A parameterized set-associative cache must generate metadata write-enable masks using the actual configured number of ways. If the design hardcodes a two-way mask inside a directory or tag store that otherwise supports N ways, writes and reset wipes only affect the low ways. Higher ways can retain stale or uninitialized metadata, producing incorrect hits, misses, dirty tracking, or flush behavior when associativity exceeds two.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: directory way-enable generation in a parameterized set-associative cache
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The cache is configured with associativity other than 2, especially when writing metadata for a selected way or wiping all ways during reset or initialization.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Truncate the way-enable mask to two bits, or otherwise hardcode the associativity used by the metadata write port.
portability_notes: Apply this to any directory, tag RAM, or metadata array whose write-enable mask should scale with associativity.
The most portable signature is a one-hot selected-way mask or full-way reset mask that is derived from a constant width instead of the configuration parameter.
The bug may stay latent in two-way configurations but is still a real DUT correctness bug in a reusable parameterized design.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the metadata write port that emits a one-hot way-enable mask for the cache directory or tag array.
Replace the parameterized way count with a hardcoded two-way width, or slice the generated mask down to the low two bits.
Apply the same truncation to any full-way mask used during reset, wipe, or invalidate operations.
Leave victim selection and status arrays unchanged so the resulting failure comes from inconsistent write coverage across ways.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces hardcoded `2`-wide waymask generation with `params.cache.ways` for both selected-way writes and all-way wipe writes.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In `ventus/src/L2cache/Directory_test.scala`, change the `cc_dir.io.w.req.bits.apply(... waymask=...)` expression back from `params.cache.ways` to a hardcoded width of `2` in both `UIntToOH` and `Fill`.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Directory metadata updates miss higher-numbered ways, so those ways can retain stale valid, dirty, or tag state and cause incorrect cache hit, miss, victim, flush, or invalidate behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The patched expression is the directory's actual SRAM write-enable mask.
The same module parameterizes all other way-dependent structures by `params.cache.ways`, so the old literal `2` was an outlier.
The module is instantiated by the L2 cache scheduler, which grounds it as live DUT logic despite the `_test` filename.
notes: This fix is branch-ported in dataset items 195, 197, and 198.
If the target DUT is permanently two-way, the injected bug may not manifest without increasing associativity.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 目录写 way mask 的生成逻辑，使其使用实际配置的相联度，而不是写死为两路。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 L2Cache 缺陷。
被修改的文件定义的是由 `Scheduler.scala` 实例化的真实目录模块，而不是单纯的宿主侧测试脚本。
补丁修正了正常写入和复位擦除路径上的目录写使能逻辑。
disqualifiers: 该缺陷与配置有关，主要在 cache 相联度不等于 2 时显现。
evidence: 补丁把 `UIntToOH(io.write.bits.way, 2)` 改为 `UIntToOH(io.write.bits.way, params.cache.ways)`，同时把 `Fill(2, !wipeDone)` 改为 `Fill(params.cache.ways, !wipeDone)`。
周围模块在数组、状态位、victim 选择和 SRAM 实例化中都使用 `params.cache.ways`，说明原来的常量 `2` 与 DUT 其他部分不一致。
`ventus/src/L2cache/Scheduler.scala` 中存在 `Module(new Directory_test(params))`，证明该逻辑属于真实 cache 数据通路。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个参数化的组相联 cache 必须按照实际配置的 way 数生成元数据写使能 mask。如果目录或 tag 存储虽然支持 N 路，却在内部把 write-enable mask 写死为两路，那么写入和复位擦除只会作用于低位 way。高位 way 可能保留陈旧或未初始化的元数据，在相联度大于 2 时导致命中、未命中、脏位跟踪或 flush 行为错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 参数化组相联 cache 中的目录 way 使能生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: cache 配置的相联度不是 2，尤其是在向某个选中 way 写元数据，或在复位、初始化时擦除全部 way 的场景下。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把目录元数据写端口的 way-enable mask 截断为两位，或者在该端口把相联度硬编码为 2。
portability_notes: 可应用于任何目录、tag RAM 或元数据数组，其写使能 mask 理应随着相联度参数缩放。
最通用的识别特征是：选中 way 的 one-hot mask 或 reset 全写 mask 由常量宽度生成，而不是由配置参数生成。
在两路配置下该缺陷可能潜伏不暴露，但对可复用的参数化 DUT 来说仍然是真实的正确性缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 cache 目录或 tag 数组的元数据写端口，以及其 one-hot way-enable 生成逻辑。
把参数化的 way 数替换成写死的两路宽度，或者把生成后的 mask 截断为低两位。
对 reset、wipe 或 invalidate 路径中的全路写 mask 注入同样的截断错误。
保持 victim 选择和状态数组逻辑不变，使最终故障体现为“部分路没有被正确写到”。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Directory_test 的元数据写端口 waymask 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把选中路写入和全路擦除两条路径中的硬编码 `2`，统一替换为 `params.cache.ways`。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 `ventus/src/L2cache/Directory_test.scala` 中，把 `cc_dir.io.w.req.bits.apply(... waymask=...)` 里的 `params.cache.ways` 改回硬编码的 `2`，同时回退 `UIntToOH` 和 `Fill` 两处宽度。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 目录元数据更新无法覆盖高编号的 way，导致这些 way 保留陈旧的 valid、dirty 或 tag 状态，从而引发 cache 命中、未命中、victim、flush 或 invalidate 行为错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁修改的表达式就是目录 SRAM 的真实写使能 mask。
同一模块中其他所有与 way 相关的结构都使用 `params.cache.ways` 参数化，因此原来的字面量 `2` 是明显异常点。
尽管文件名带有 `_test`，但该模块被 L2 cache scheduler 直接实例化，属于真实 DUT 逻辑。
notes: 该修复在数据项 195、197、198 中以分支移植形式重复出现。
如果目标 DUT 永远固定为两路，相同注入在默认配置下可能不会显现，需要提高相联度才能触发。
